title: Neon Neuron Orb
description: A glowing, multicolored neuron-like structure with branching dendrites and pink nodes floats inside a transparent spherical glass orb. The orb rests on a dark metallic stand with dripping paint effects, set against a misty forest background with vibrant paint splatters radiating outward.
prompt: A surreal glowing neuron with bright pink nodes and colorful branching dendrites in yellow, green, purple and blue, floating inside a large transparent glass sphere. The sphere sits on a dark pedestal with colorful paint dripping down. Behind the orb is a misty green forest. Vibrant paint splatters in pink, purple and yellow explode around the sphere against a soft gradient background.
